topic: Audit whether OpenCode command surfaces and tooling are linked to and aware of the new root ROUTER.md parent-skill creation standard (first-class ROUTER.md at hub root with router_state active/stage1-only, replacing legacy shared/references/smart-routing.md). Investigate create command family, doctor command family, and other surfaces (CI scripts, skill advisor metadata, agents, mode-registry/hub-router schema docs, validators).

noveltyJustification: First-pass full coverage of the create family; established the standard landed end-to-end (YAML contract + template + init_skill.py + validator + presentation + parity test + mirrors), with only a cosmetic filename residue

ruledOut.approach: Treating flat create-skill flow as a ROUTER.md gap
ruledOut.reason: Flat/standalone skills do not own a root ROUTER.md (class-H parent hubs only); init_skill() writing graph-metadata.json without ROUTER.md is correct

focus: Doctor command family (.opencode/commands/doctor) smart-routing assumptions + ROUTER.md validation
noveltyJustification: Confirmed per-hub check 12 exists and is robust, but discovered the two real gaps the brief predicted: the fleet class gate ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs is ROUTER-blind and no doctor route sweeps the seven hubs' root ROUTER.md contracts

ruledOut.reason: DB rebuild orchestrator with mutation boundaries explicitly forbidding skill body writes; ROUTER.md out of scope
Diagnose MCP server install/boot, not skill hub structure

focus: CI scripts + skill advisor metadata/index + validators re legacy path / root ROUTER.md awareness
noveltyJustification: CI already runs ROUTER.md check 12 fleet-wide via glob-enrollment of the 7 registry hubs, but the trigger-path omission means editing the very file under validation bypasses the gate; advisor/validators/compiled-route are intentionally ROUTER-agnostic; package_skill smart-router hits are a different (flat-skill section) concept

ruledOut.approach: Skill advisor as a ROUTER.md consumer
ruledOut.reason: Advisor harvesters walk references/+assets/ frontmatter and project mode-registry/leaf-manifest pairs; root ROUTER.md is not an advisor input by design

ruledOut.approach: package_skill.py as a legacy smart-routing hit
ruledOut.reason: Its SMART ROUTING markers validate the flat-skill section pattern (skill_smart_router.md), a distinct surface from the hub root ROUTER.md contract

focus: sk-create-skill smart-routing string hits (8 files) — legit vs stale
noveltyJustification: Confirmed the sk-create-skill hits are all legitimate templates/references/contracts/test fixtures; net-new: exact count is 8 files not 5, the template filename is cosmetic legacy-residue naming, and a rename is explicitly ruled out as functional churn

ruledOut.reason: Cosmetic naming only; rename would ripple through create YAMLs, hub template, schema docs, nested-packets doc, skill-smart-router.md, and the markdown agent with no functional gain

focus: Seven-hub ROUTER.md sweep + remaining agents + dangling legacy citations (broaden angles)
noveltyJustification: Established ground-truth conformance (7/7 active ROUTER.md, zero legacy files on disk) while surfacing three concrete stale-citation/doc-link gaps (sk-code phase-detection dangling links, deep-alignment section citations, deep-review ANCHOR) plus conformant characterization of benchmark replay and playbook content

ruledOut.reason: All seven hubs are active with valid skill_pointer and four-part versions; fleet-wide state is uniform and conformant

ruledOut.approach: router-replay.cjs as a legacy authoring hit
ruledOut.reason: Its legacy-path probes are ordered fallbacks behind ROUTER.md and hub-router projection; migrated hubs replay from ROUTER.md/hub-router.json
